Description: Professional printing for Nose Cone, Body, and Fins. High heat & impact resistance.
Digital flight computer to record altitude, speed, and flight duration
2-pack of mid-power motors with 5-second parachute delay
Ripstop nylon parachute (won't melt or tear like plastic)
Fireproof tether to connect the nose cone to the rocket body
Fireproof blanket to protect the parachute from the ejection charge
Cardboard tube to insulate the 3D printed plastic from the motor heat
Mounting buttons to slide the rocket up a professional launch rail
High-strength adhesive required for bonding rocketry components
